extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders affected by Department of Education rulemaking (borrowers, postsecondary institutions, accrediting agencies, grant applicants, State agencies, practitioners, and commenters)
extracted.subtask_description: An index/listing of Department of Education rule documents (final rules, interim final rules, priorities, corrections, and interpretive guidance) with abstracts describing regulatory requirements, criteria, and program priorities used to evaluate or implement education programs and benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reimagining and Improving Student Education — Federal student loan program final regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Secretary amends regulations for Title IV HEA programs to implement statutory changes in Public Law 119-21: establish new loan limits for graduate/professional students and parents; phase out the Graduate PLUS Program; phase out existing Income-Contingent Repayment (ICR) plans; create a Tiered Standard repayment option; establish a new Repayment Assistance Plan; enable borrowers who previously rehabilitated a defaulted loan a second chance to rehabilitate and resume repayment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2026-08556 (pub. 2026-05-01). Changes include substantive program eligibility, repayment-plan structure, loan limits, and default/rehabilitation policies to implement statutory changes in the Working Families Tax Cuts Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final priority & definitions — Career Pathways and Workforce Readiness
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces a final priority and definitions for use in discretionary grant programs; Secretary may use entire priority or components, and these priorities augment previously published Secretary's Supplemental Priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2026-07084 (pub. 2026-04-13). Provides priorities and definitions to be used as selection/evaluation criteria in Department grant competitions; components may be applied individually or in combination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final priority & definitions — Advancing Artificial Intelligence in Education
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces one priority and related definitions for use in discretionary grant programs; Secretary may apply the entire priority or parts and it augments earlier supplemental priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2026-07087 (pub. 2026-04-13). Establishes definitional and priority criteria for grant competitions related to AI in education.

rubrics_metrics.name: William D. Ford Federal Direct Loan Program — Correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Correction to a final rule governing Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) in 34 CFR 685.219.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2026-04978 (pub. 2026-03-13). Identifies technical corrections to previously published regulatory text; does not create new substantive policy but affects the regulatory language implementers rely upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory guidance — Criteria and process for initial recognition of an accrediting agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpretive rule setting forth the Department's interpretation of regulations at the Criteria for Recognition and the Recognition Process governing an accrediting agency's submission for initial recognition; provisions designed to reduce unnecessary barriers and promote competition in the market for assessing education quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2026-03953 (pub. 2026-02-27). Provides interpretive criteria and process guidance that affect how accrediting agencies prepare and how the Department evaluates initial recognition applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: William D. Ford Federal Direct Loan Program — PSLF employer eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes new regulations for PSLF (34 CFR 685.219) to exclude employers that engage in specified enumerated illegal activities such that they have a substantial illegal purpose; defines obligations/processes tied to determinations of an employer; clarifies that borrowers receive full credit for work performed until the Secretary's effective determination date; establishes methods for an employer to regain eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-19729 (pub. 2025-10-31). Sets standards for which employers qualify for PSLF credit and defines processes for determinations and re-eligibility to protect program integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final priorities & definitions — Evidence-Based Literacy, Educational Choice, Returning Education to States
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces three priorities and related definitions for discretionary grant programs; Secretary may use full priority or components; replaces earlier supplemental priorities published prior to January 20, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-17310 (pub. 2025-09-09). Establishes definitional and priority criteria that programs and applicants must meet or address in grant competitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final waiver & extension — Arts in Education National Program project period with funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Secretary waives EDGAR requirements that generally prohibit extensions involving obligation of additional Federal funds to enable one project under ALN 84.351A to receive additional funding through specified date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-14188 (pub. 2025-07-28). Procedural waiver/extension standard permitting continuation of federal funding beyond normal restrictions for a specified project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of revenue under Title IV (90/10 Rule clarification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises prior interpretation and clarifies classification of revenue received by proprietary institutions under Title IV Revenue and Non-Federal Education Assistance Funds regulations (the '90/10 Rule').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-12554 (pub. 2025-07-07). Alters how revenue types are classified for compliance with 90/10 calculations; affects institutional reporting and eligibility determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovative Rehabilitation Training Program — priorities & requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces final priority and requirements under the Innovative Rehabilitation Training program (ALN 84.263G) to promote improved methods of training VR counseling, engagement, and service delivery for State VR agency personnel and other professionals to lead to quality employment outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-11807 (pub. 2025-06-26). Sets programmatic priorities and application requirements that will be used to evaluate grant proposals for training and TA in vocational rehabilitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance priority — IDEA Data Management Center (State data collection)
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces a priority for the IDEA Data Management Center under Technical Assistance on State Data Collection program to improve States' capacity to meet data collection and reporting requirements under IDEA Parts B and C.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-11608 (pub. 2025-06-25). Priority will be used to award a cooperative agreement to provide TA for States' IDEA data systems; defines expected functions and TA outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance priority — National Fiscal Data Center for IDEA Part B and C fiscal data
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces priority for a National Technical Assistance Center to improve State capacity to collect, report, analyze, and use accurate IDEA Part B and C fiscal data; Center will customize TA to meet each State's needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-11599 (pub. 2025-06-25). Establishes selection criteria and expected deliverables for a Fiscal Data Center cooperative agreement to support State fiscal data practices under IDEA.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Vocational Rehabilitation Technical Assistance Center priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces a priority, requirements, and definitions under the Rehabilitation Training program (ALN 84.264L) to award a cooperative agreement for an NVRTAC to provide training and TA to State VR personnel to upgrade competencies and improve VR services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-11103 (pub. 2025-06-17). Sets evaluative requirements and definitions applicants must meet for cooperative agreement competitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rehabilitation Long-Term Training Program — priorities and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Announces priorities and requirements under the RLTT program focused on the Comprehensive System of Personnel Development (CSPD) and six rehabilitation topic areas to address national needs like retention and recruitment of VR personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-11117 (pub. 2025-06-17). Establishes substantive and programmatic criteria for RLTT funding competitions and applicant eligibility/requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjustment of Civil Monetary Penalties for Inflation
rubrics_metrics.description: Issues final regulations to adjust the Department's civil monetary penalties (CMPs) for inflation, providing the 2025 annual inflation adjustments to penalty amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-01419 (pub. 2025-01-21). Implements statutorily-required inflation adjustments; affects enforcement/penalty calculations across Department regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indian Education Discretionary Grant Programs — Professional Development program
rubrics_metrics.description: Amends regulations governing the Professional Development program under ESEA to establish priorities, requirements, and a program definition, including a priority for educator retention projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-01317 (pub. 2025-01-17). Sets definitional and priority criteria to guide grant competitions and applicant proposals for Indian Education PD funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Income-Contingent Repayment Plan Options (final)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopts as final an interim final rule amending regulations governing income-contingent repayment plans to satisfy HEA obligations; revises the last date for most borrowers to enroll in ICR or Pay As You Earn plans from July 1, 2024 to July 1, 2027 to allow administrative changes during litigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2025-00724 (pub. 2025-01-15). Narrow-scope regulatory change affecting borrower eligibility timelines for ICR/PAYE enrollment; procedural compliance with court injunction considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Integrity & Institutional Quality — Distance education and return of Title IV funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Amends Student Assistance General Provisions regarding participation in Title IV programs to promote program integrity and institutional quality; clarifies, updates, and consolidates provisions applying to distance education and return of Title IV funds; closes out remaining NPRM provisions for TRIO programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2024-31031 (pub. 2025-01-03). Affects institutional obligations for distance education participation, calculation/return of Title IV funds, and related program integrity standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improving Income Driven Repayment — Correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Corrects a technical error in the July 10, 2023 final regulations amending income-driven repayment; contains no substantive changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2024-31217 (pub. 2024-12-31). Technical correction to previously published IDR regulations; important for accurate regulatory text though not changing policy substance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Income Contingent Repayment Plan Options (IFR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interim final rule amending regulations governing ICR plans to ensure Department meets statutory obligation to offer an income-contingent repayment plan; revises enrollment end date for ICR/PAYE from July 1, 2024 to July 1, 2027 to allow administrative compliance with an appellate injunction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document number 2024-26698 (pub. 2024-11-15). Time-limited eligibility revision to align program administration with pending litigation and required statutory obligations.
